descriptionChirho: To suffer affliction, tribulation, or distress; passive and middle forms expressing the experience of being pressed, troubled, or oppressed — the condition of believers under persecution or hardship.
Active sense: to afflict, oppress, or cause distress to someone; the agent who brings tribulation upon others.

Physical pressing or crowding against someone, as when a crowd presses upon Jesus so that he might not be crushed (Mark 3:9); literal spatial compression rather than emotional or spiritual affliction.
Perfect passive participle used adjectivally to describe a way or path as narrow, constricted, compressed — τεθλιμμένη ἡ ὁδός 'the way that leads to life is narrow' (Matt 7:14).
